lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gills. These are organized into roughly six vertical columns, with each column containing 2-3 primary nodes aligned along horizontal axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae. High-intensity blobs are located at these intersection points, creating a repetitive geometric lattice pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge transitioning into shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs. These are most concentrated at the anterior base of the fin and become more diffuse toward the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, discrete spots on its dorsal surface. The head region also shows a significantly higher spatial frequency of smaller spots compared to the lateral flank.
